## What's new

Kultr 2.0 brings everything from Kultr for iOS 2.0 to Android.

**A new look: Cream**
- **Cream pages, warm black text and one orange** for everything you can tap. In dark mode it's warm charcoal with a brighter orange, and Night mode is still pure black. The washes, glows and tinted backgrounds are gone; the album cover is the colour on screen.
- **A new icon: the K in orange on cream.** Settings → Appearance → App icon switches between **Cream**, **Ember**, **Night** and **Classic** (the blue one).
- **Library is a list:** Playlists, Crates, Artists, Albums, Songs, Genres, Tags, Favourites, Downloads and Radio, with your most recently added albums below. Each opens on its own page with a filter field.
- **Home:** tap a shelf's title, like "Played the most ›", to see all of it.
- **Album, artist and playlist pages** have wide Play and Shuffle buttons, and each track's ••• is orange. In the player, year, genre, format, bitrate and rating are one line instead of five pills.

**Stations**
- **Endless mixes from your own library.** Warm Up, Night Drive, Peak Hour, Deep Focus, Wind Down, Unplayed gems, Favourites and a station per decade, as the first shelf on Home. Each next track is the one that mixes best out of the one before.
- **The dial.** Turn it to choose; it ticks at each station. While a station plays, turning it mixes into the next one.
- **Your own.** Every station is a set of rules you can change: tempo, energy, key, genres, years, your tags, rating, never played, favourites and when the music was added. The editor counts the tracks that fit as you go.

**Planning and asking**
- **Energy planner.** Tap **Plan a set** on Home and draw how the next hour should feel, calm to peak. Kultr builds a set that follows your line, with tempos and keys that mix. Play it, or keep it as a playlist.
- **Search does things.** Type "play Night Drive", "shuffle" and an artist, "sleep in 30 minutes", "stop after this song", "next", "mix now", "open settings" or "plan an hour", and tap the orange row or press Search on the keyboard.

**Your collection**
- **Crates.** Library → Crates: folders of albums, artists and tracks. Fill one by hand (Add to crate in any track's menu, and on album and artist pages) or by rules ("4 stars and up, added this year"), and keep it as a playlist on your server if you like.
- **Notes and tags.** Album and artist pages have **Your notes**: tags of your own and a note. Tap a tag to see everything with it, play it, or make a crate of it. They stay on your phone, and in a settings backup.
- **Rediscover.** A new Home shelf with albums you hearted or played a lot and haven't played for a year.
- **Monthly recap.** Listening has a page for each month: how long you listened, your top tracks, albums and artists, your longest day and your first listens.

**Make it yours**
- **Kultr Studio.** Settings → Appearance → Kultr Studio: the whole look in one place. Start from Cream, Night, Ember, Paper or Console, change colours, corners, glass and the playhead, put the player together from its parts in the order you like, and write its info line yourself (`{?bpm:{bpm} BPM}{?key: · {key}}`). Share your style as a link or a file; opening someone's link shows the style first. Links work between Android and iOS.
- **Widgets on Home.** Now playing, your listening this week, the next mix, a station, a crate or a shortcut, small, medium or large. Hold one for its size, to move or remove it, and to add more; Settings → Home page has the same.

**The player**
- **Hold Next to mix.** Hold the Next button and Kultr mixes into the next track over the whole crossfade instead of skipping. A tap still skips.
- **Glass lens.** Drag along the progress bar and a lens shows the time large, with the beats around it.
- **Save the session.** The button at the top of Up next keeps what you've played, or the whole queue, as a playlist.
- **Wind down.** With a sleep timer, the last 15 minutes play Karousel's calmest picks first (Settings → Playback, or the sleep timer itself).

## What's different

- **What's new, every time.** The first start after an update shows what changed, including every update since the version you last opened. **Settings → About → Update log** has every version from 1.0.0.
- **Loading and empty pages.** Pages show their shape while they load instead of a spinner, and empty pages say why and what to do.
- **Karousel is steadier:** while the last track plays it keeps looking (every 15 seconds) instead of giving up, and a slow server no longer holds it up.
- **Messages** show above the full player too.

**Your settings:** on the first start after updating, Kultr moves to the new look. Periwinkle becomes orange, the colour stops coming from the artwork, and the blurred cover behind pages turns off; a colour you picked yourself is kept. Settings → Appearance turns any of these back on. The Stations and Rediscover shelves are added to Home once; take them off in Settings → Home page if you don't want them.

## Under the hood

- Cleaned up throughout: unused code, models and imports removed, every compiler warning fixed, and the pager, chips and gradients replaced by the list, the info line and flat colour.
- Stations, crates, notes, widgets and Studio styles use the same settings file as Kultr for iOS and the web, so a backup moves them between apps.

## Install

If you have Kultr 1.5.0 or later, tap the banner at the top of the app, or go to **Settings → About → Version → Check for updates**, and then **Update**.

Otherwise download **Kultr-2.0.0.apk** below and open it on your phone. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your servers, music folders, library, listening history, analysis and downloads. Requires Android 8.0 or later.

Signed with the Kultr release key (SHA-256 `3C:26:16:4A:FD:6F:C1:30:F5:7D:A5:2B:4F:04:AB:2B:E8:3C:89:25:50:89:6F:C9:43:57:D2:E0:B8:51:6F:E0`).
